record.question: Which of the following is 'subscript' short-cut key?
record.explanation: Answer C: ctrl + =. Ctrl+= is the conventional Windows Microsoft Office subscript shortcut. Microsoft’s own Office shortcut table distinguishes it from Ctrl+Shift+Plus for superscript. The source should name the application/platform because shortcuts are not universal. Historical/source note: Microsoft Office on Windows with the relevant keyboard mapping; application/platform context omitted by the source. Reference: https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/accessibility/powerpoint/use-keyboard-shortcuts-to-create-powerpoint-presentations. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
